verdict.rationale: Paddle documents payout reconciliation reports that can be generated via the API. They reconcile payouts to transactions and adjustments, sum balance movements against remittance advice, and itemize gross, tax, fee and chargeback amounts. Its hosted MCP server, through the codemode `execute` tool, lets an agent call the full API and "generate reports and analyze revenue… transaction patterns." This covers an agent reconciling each payout (bank deposit) to its underlying charges. Missing for 10: direct payout and balance-transaction list endpoints (reconciliation runs through asynchronous report generation, not per-object queries), explicit documentation of an agent running the reconciliation report through MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
